QuestInfo.name: [Hieizan Temple] The End of Princess No
QuestInfo.0: Everything disappeared, as if it were all an illusion.
QuestInfo.1: Just like an illusion, everything disappeared. Perhaps it WAS an illusion. The ritual to summon the Demon King failed, but you should still go after the princess.
QuestInfo.2: The wicked Princess No escaped from #m811000029:# and hid at the end of the central hall. Return to Ayame for now.

0.msg: I must go further west to get to the shrine.
